'''2008 Match Play Championship Day 1 Nate Meeker LS Agents In The Court''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nate Meeker]] at [[2008 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|JPSD-L-agentsinthecourt.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS14]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
